Optional local/global/map buffers must not alias, output strides must be valid, and every unsupported backend/SP/shape/domain retains original mapping.
Parent and candidate must use exact pinned owned sources, isolated JIT module/cache identities and matching common dependencies; do not mutate installed sources.
